description: Compact, precomputed Earth-reference target ranges derived from checksum-pinned Natural Earth, NOAA ETOPO 2022, WorldClim 2.1, HydroBASINS v1.c, and HydroRIVERS v1.0 sources. Raw source data are not required to evaluate these targets.
name: canonical_earth_empirical_targets_v1

etopo_2022.source_citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. 2022: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model.
etopo_2022.source_license: Produced by NOAA NCEI; not subject to copyright protection within the United States.
etopo_2022.source_native_resolution: 60 arc-second global surface grid; 1-degree center-point stride response

hydrobasins_level3.source_citation: Lehner, B. and Grill, G. (2013). Global river hydrography and network routing: baseline data and new approaches to study the world's large river systems.
hydrobasins_level3.source_geographic_coverage: All nine HydroBASINS v1.c regions; near-global non-Antarctic land coverage
hydrobasins_level3.source_license: Freely available for scientific, educational, and commercial use under the HydroSHEDS license agreement; attribution and license terms apply.
hydrobasins_level3.source_native_resolution: HydroBASINS standard Pfafstetter level 3, derived from HydroSHEDS 15 arc-second hydrography

hydrorivers_v10.source_citation: Lehner, B. and Grill, G. (2013). Global river hydrography and network routing: baseline data and new approaches to study the world's large river systems.
hydrorivers_v10.source_geographic_coverage: Near-global land excluding Antarctica; source quality is lower north of 60 degrees north
hydrorivers_v10.source_license: Freely available for scientific, educational, and commercial use under the HydroSHEDS license agreement; attribution and license terms apply.
hydrorivers_v10.source_native_resolution: River reaches extracted from HydroSHEDS 15 arc-second hydrography with 10 km2 upstream-area or 0.1 m3/s discharge initiation

worldclim_prec.source_citation: Fick, S.E. and R.J. Hijmans, 2017. WorldClim 2: new 1-km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas.
worldclim_prec.source_license: Academic and other non-commercial use; redistribution and commercial use require prior permission.

worldclim_tavg.source_citation: Fick, S.E. and R.J. Hijmans, 2017. WorldClim 2: new 1-km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas.
worldclim_tavg.source_license: Academic and other non-commercial use; redistribution and commercial use require prior permission.

targets.tolerance_basis: Absolute Earth-like model-fit tolerance for generated coast variability; not a statistical confidence interval.

targets.source_processing: OPeNDAP z[30:60:10770][30:60:21570], then nearest-coordinate sampling at 4096 native Fibonacci centers
targets.tolerance_basis: Absolute Earth-like model-fit tolerance; not a statistical confidence interval.

targets.source_processing: OPeNDAP z[30:60:10770][30:60:21570], then nearest-coordinate sampling at 4096 native Fibonacci centers
targets.tolerance_basis: Twenty-percent Earth-like model-fit tolerance; not a statistical confidence interval.

targets.source_processing: OPeNDAP z[30:60:10770][30:60:21570], then nearest-coordinate sampling at 4096 native Fibonacci centers
targets.tolerance_basis: Fifteen-percent Earth-like model-fit tolerance; not a statistical confidence interval.

targets.source_processing: Nine checksum-pinned regional DBF tables aggregated globally; ENDO values 1 or 2 counted as endorheic
targets.source_variable_units: fraction of level-3 basin polygons with ENDO > 0
targets.tolerance_basis: Five-percentage-point coarse terminal-basin model-fit tolerance. Generated coverage includes whole resolution-dependent watersheds with centroid latitude at or north of 60 degrees south to exclude Antarctica; generated units are not a Pfafstetter hierarchy and this is not a statistical confidence interval.

targets.source_processing: Nine checksum-pinned regional DBF tables aggregated globally; SUB_AREA summed for ENDO values 1 or 2
targets.source_variable_units: SUB_AREA-weighted fraction of level-3 basin polygons with ENDO > 0
targets.tolerance_basis: Eight-percentage-point endorheic-area model-fit tolerance. Summed terminal-watershed area is compared over generated coverage with centroid latitude at or north of 60 degrees south; HydroBASINS lumping and virtual endorheic connections remain semantic limitations, and this is not a statistical confidence interval.

targets.source_processing: Stream global DBF; select NEXT_DOWN = 0 and UPLAND_SKM >= 1000000; ordinary least-squares fit of log(DIST_UP_KM) on log(UPLAND_SKM)
targets.source_variable_units: dimensionless exponent from log main-channel length versus log upstream area
targets.tolerance_basis: Absolute coarse-network Hack-exponent model-fit tolerance. Source and generated fits use terminal networks/basins above the same one-million-km2 floor; not a statistical confidence interval.

targets.source_processing: Stream global DBF; select NEXT_DOWN = 0 and UPLAND_SKM >= 1000000; ordinary least-squares fit of log(DIST_UP_KM) on log(UPLAND_SKM)
targets.source_variable_units: natural-log root-mean-square residual around the fitted Hack relation
targets.tolerance_basis: Physical-floor interval from zero to the HydroRIVERS natural-log RMSE plus 0.25, allowing coarse generated drainage paths more multiplicative scatter while retaining a bounded comparison; not a statistical confidence interval.

targets.source_processing: Twelve GeoTIFF months sampled at 4096 native Fibonacci centers; complete land samples only; monthly values averaged per cell then across land
targets.tolerance_basis: Three-degree Earth-like land-climate model-fit tolerance; not a statistical confidence interval.

targets.source_processing: Twelve GeoTIFF months sampled at 4096 native Fibonacci centers; complete land samples only; per-cell monthly maximum minus minimum averaged across land
targets.tolerance_basis: Four-degree Earth-like seasonal-range model-fit tolerance; not a statistical confidence interval.

targets.source_processing: Twelve GeoTIFF months sampled at 4096 native Fibonacci centers; complete land samples only; monthly precipitation summed per cell then averaged across land
targets.tolerance_basis: Twenty-five-percent Earth-like land-precipitation model-fit tolerance; not a statistical confidence interval.
